item.title: Frederick Gaudreau scores twice as Kraken separate from Red Wings
item.description: Frederick Gaudreau scored two of Seattle's four straight second-period goals as the Kraken pulled away to a 6-3 victory over the host Detroit Red Wings on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Frederick Gaudreau scored two of Seattle's four straight second-period goals as the Kraken pulled away to a 6-3 victory over the host Detroit Red Wings on Friday. Ben Meyers supplied a goal and two assists, while Berkly Catton had a goal and an assist. Mackie Samoskevich and Vince Dunn also scored for the Kraken, while Philipp Grubauer made 37 saves. William Wallinder and Michael Brandsegg-Nygard scored their first NHL goals for Detroit. Viktor Arvidsson scored for the third straight game. The Red Wings had a 16-5 shots on goal advantage in the first period but it ended in a 1-1 tie. With Jordan Eberle in the penalty box for slashing, the Red Wings scored at 9:19 of the period. Lucas Raymond took a shot from the right side that trickled through the legs of Grubauer. Arvidsson then tapped it into the net. Catton tied it with 5:08 left in the period. He took a pass from Kaapo Kakko and pushed a backhander past Detroit starting goalie John Gibson on the short side. Josh Mahura picked up the second assist. Wallinder scored his breakthrough with a shot from the point four minutes into the second period. Alex DeBrincat and Brandsegg-Nygård collected the assists. Gaudreau scored 39 seconds later to tie it. He converted from short range off a behind-the-net pass from Ryan Winterton. Meyers had the second assist. Samoskevich gave the Kraken the lead at 6:59 of the period. He scored in front off a feed from Jared McCann. Gaudreau's second goal of the game came at 7:44 of the period. He lifted a shot over Gibson's glove from the left circle. Winterton and Meyers once again had the assists. Meyers made it 5-2 with 5:55 left in the period with assists from Catton and Brandon Montour. Right after serving a penalty, Meyers skated into the offensive zone and fired a shot from the right circle past Gibson. That ended Gibson's night, as he was pulled for Daniil Tarasov. Dunn scored during a 5-on-3 advantage in the third period. --Field Level Media

item.title: Capitals prevail after Rangers lose G Igor Shesterkin to injury
item.description: Boone Jenner scored the tiebreaking goal late in the second period and the host Washington Capitals won 3-1 on Friday, cooling off the New York Rangers, who lost star goaltender Igor Shesterkin to a lower-body injury.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Boone Jenner scored the tiebreaking goal late in the second period and the host Washington Capitals won 3-1 on Friday, cooling off the New York Rangers, who lost star goaltender Igor Shesterkin to a lower-body injury. Timothy Liljegren also scored, Tom Wilson added an empty-netter and Logan Thompson made 22 saves for Washington, which has won three of its first four on the season. The Capitals also snapped the Rangers' four-game winning streak. Shesterkin, who entered with a 3-1-0 record, a 1.75 goals-against average and a .926 save percentage this season, appeared to awkwardly jam his right skate into the goalpost while sliding into position to make a save with 11:40 remaining in the second period of a 1-1 contest. The former Vezina Trophy winner, who stopped 13 of the 14 shots he saw on Friday, remained down on the ice for several minutes and had to be helped to the bench by a pair of teammates. Backup Dylan Garand, who made 22 saves in New York's 2-0 win at Detroit on Oct. 2, replaced Shesterkin and stopped 11 of 12 shots. As Garand manned the Rangers' net, Washington took the lead with 2:22 left in the middle frame via a turnover in the New York zone. Jenner intercepted the ill-advised pass from Rangers star Adam Fox in the slot, and he converted a snap shot for his first goal as a Capital. After recording a hat trick in the Rangers' 5-2 win over the rival New York Islanders on Tuesday, Alexis Lafreniere opened the scoring with 9:43 remaining in the first period on a power play. Skating into the high slot, Lafreniere worked for enough of an opening to beat a seemingly off-balance Thompson. Washington tied it 6:08 into the second period. Liljegren hammered a point shot that found its way past a screened Shesterkin. Capitals superstar Alex Ovechkin, the league's all-time leader with 929 goals and playing in his 22nd and final NHL season, recorded two shots on goal but remained goalless on the campaign. --Field Level Media

item.title: Isaias weakens to Category 1 hurricane after Florida landfall, NHC says
item.description: Nearly 380,000 people in Florida and more than 210,000 in Alabama were left without power as the storm hit shore.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hurricane Isaias rapidly lost windspeed on Friday, weakening into a Category 1 event after making landfall near Destin, Florida, the US National Hurricane Center said, but warned of danger from storm surges and floods as power links snapped. The hurricane was about 65 miles (105 km) west-northwest of Panama City, Florida, packing maximum sustained winds of 90 mph (150 kph), the NHC said in its most recent advisory. The agency warned against a life-threatening storm surge affecting the Gulf Coast as dangerous hurricane conditions and flash floods spread inland. The hurricane is expected to cross Alabama and into the Tennessee Valley on the weekend, the agency added. Nearly 380,000 people in Florida and more than 210,000 in Alabama were left without power as the storm hit shore, the website Poweroutage.us showed. "Emergency declarations have been approved in Florida and Alabama to ensure federal resources are available to respond to Isaias," Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said on X. Florida's emergency services urged residents to shelter in place and watch for hurricane conditions across the state's north after Isaias hit land as a category 2 storm.

item.title: Trump estime que la Norvège porte une "tache indélébile" pour ne pas lui avoir décerné le prix Nobel de la paix
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump s'est plaint amèrement vendredi de ne pas avoir reçu le prix Nobel de la paix, estimant que cette décision avait jeté une tache sur la Norvège.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump s'est plaint amèrement vendredi de ne pas avoir reçu le prix Nobel de la paix, estimant que cette décision avait jeté une tache sur la Norvège. Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, ancienne juge de la Cour pénale internationale (CPI), qui a supervisé une enquête de l'Onu ayant conclu qu'Israël avait commis un génocide à Gaza, a remporté vendredi le [USN:L8N45V0JP TEXT:"prix Nobel de la paix"] pour "ses efforts en faveur de la paix et du droit international". Donald Trump a estimé que Navi Pillay était une "inconnue" lors d'un rassemblement à Syracuse, dans l'Etat de New York, organisé en amont des élections de mi-mandat aux Etats-Unis. "Je n'ai jamais entendu parler de cette personne. Personne n'en a entendu parler." "Il s'agit d'une tache indélébile pour la Norvège et pour ces gens qui ont pris une décision si honteuse et embarrassante", a dit le locataire de la Maison blanche. "Le prix Nobel de la paix a été discrédité pour toujours par une poignée d'idéologues radicaux, hostiles à la démocratie et véritables ennemis de la civilisation. Nous n'oublierons pas, Norvège", a dit Donald Trump. Le prix Nobel de la paix est remis à Oslo, en Norvège. L'administration américaine a annoncé, quelques heures après que Navi Pillay a reçu le prix, des [USN:L8N45V1HE TEXT:"sanctions"] visant à paralyser le fonctionnement de la Cour pénale internationale (CPI).

item.title: Trump says Norway has 'indelible stain' for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Each year of his presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment at his failure to win the prize.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump reiterated his complaints on Friday about not receiving the Nobel Peace Prize, calling it a disgraceful and embarrassing decision that had left a stain on Norway, which hosts the Nobel committee. Trump unleashed on Norway hours after the committee awarded this year's prize to [USN:L8N45V0JG TEXT:"Navi Pillay,"] a former International Criminal Court judge who oversaw a UN report that concluded Israel committed genocide in Gaza. Trump called Pillay a "mystery person" during a campaign rally in Syracuse, New York. "I never heard of the person. Nobody did." Each year of his presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment at his failure to win the prize. "This is an indelible stain on the country of Norway and those people that made such a disgraceful and embarrassing decision," Trump said. He listed a number of conflicts that he [USN:L1N3UC0RP TEXT:"claimed a role in resolving"] and said he has helped prevent wars from breaking out between North and South Korea, Japan and North Korea, and China and Taiwan, without providing evidence. "The Nobel Peace Prize has been forever discredited by a handful of radical ideologues who are anti-democracy and really enemies of civilization. And we will not forget, Norway," he said.

item.title: Rangers G Igor Shesterkin exits vs. Capitals with lower-body injury
item.description: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin exited in the second period against the host Washington Capitals with a lower-body injury Friday night and did not return.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: New York Rangers goaltender Igor Shesterkin exited in the second period against the host Washington Capitals with a lower-body injury Friday night and did not return. Shesterkin, who entered the contest with a 3-1-0 record and 1.75 goals-against average on the young season, appeared to awkwardly jam his right skate into the goalpost while sliding into position to make a save with 11:40 remaining in the middle frame of a 1-1 game. He was helped off the ice without putting any pressure on his right leg. "Well, it's concerning, obviously," said Rangers coach Mike Sullivan, who didn't have any update on Shesterkin's status after the game. "He's an elite goaltender, and you don't ever want to see anybody get hurt, but, obviously, he's an important player for us." The Rangers ended up losing 3-1 to the Capitals. Shesterkin, a former Vezina Trophy winner who stopped 13 of the 14 shots he saw Friday, remained down on the ice for several minutes and had to be helped to the bench by a pair of teammates. Backup Dylan Garand, who made 22 saves in New York's 2-0 win at Detroit on Oct. 2, replaced Shesterkin. Garand finished with 11 saves on 12 shots. "It's awful. He's a pillar of this team," Rangers captain J.T. Miller said of Shesterkin getting hurt. "It stinks. ... We don't even know what's going on, but to see him leave the game is a shot to all of us, a shock to all of us. But at the same time, it means we got to step up to a man to try to get the job done, especially (Garand)." The Rangers had their four-game winning streak snapped. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝監視対象の選手・関係者の過半数が誹謗中傷受信、ＦＩＦＡ発表
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - 国際サッカー連盟（ＦＩＦＡ）は９日、２０２６年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米３カ国大会においてソーシャルメディア保護サービス（ＳＭＰＳ）によって監視された選手、監督、関係者の計１６０６人のうち、半数以上がオンライン上で誹謗中傷を受けていたと発表した。

監視対象となった１６０６人のうち８１２人が、誹謗中傷と分類されるメッセージを少なくとも１件受信した。差別的な誹謗中傷の中で最も多かったのは人種差別に関するもので、誹謗中傷全体の１２％を占めた。一般的な誹謗中傷を除くと、その割合は２０％に上った。

最も標的とされた特定の個人は１万件以上の誹謗中傷投稿を受け取り、そのうち４０％が人種差別的な内容だった。

ＳＭＰＳは１７１０万件の投稿やコメントを分析し、そのうち約２４万件が人の目による精査を経て誹謗中傷であると確認された。２９０５のアカウントについて調査が必要と判断され、７８６アカウントが審査のため法執行機関に報告された。

投稿監視ツールは、ＦＩＦＡおよび加盟協会の公式チャンネルにおける６０７０万件のコメントをスキャンし、スパムを含め９２０万件を非表示にした。

item.title: US says Chinese actions off Taiwan are 'deeply destabilising'
item.description: China's maritime actions off Taiwan's east coast are "deeply destabilising" and only worsen tension, the US State Department said, after Reuters reported the first known sighting of a Chinese militia boat in those waters in August.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's maritime actions off Taiwan's east coast are "deeply destabilising" and only worsen tension, the US State Department said, after Reuters reported the first known sighting of a Chinese [USN:L4N45S05G TEXT:"militia boat"] in those waters in August. China, which views Taiwan as its own territory, has stepped up activity off the island's [USN:L1N42902N TEXT:"east coast"] since June with regular coast guard patrols. Officials in Taiwan, which rejects Beijing's sovereignty claims, say they believe China is practicing for a possible maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets. Taipei regards the area off its east coast as critical to wartime supply routes from allies in the event of a blockade or conflict. The United States remains concerned by China's activity east of Taiwan, a State Department spokesperson said, responding to a question on the sighting of the militia boat. "China's actions are deeply destabilising," the spokesperson added. "By asserting authorities around maritime areas that Taiwan has peacefully administered for over 70 years, China only exacerbates tensions and undermines the peaceful resolution of issues that it claims to seek." The United States urges Beijing to cease its pressure against Taiwan and instead engage in "meaningful dialogue with Taiwan's democratically elected authorities", the spokesperson added. China's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. China recognises no claims of sovereignty by Taiwan, including over waters surrounding it. The United States is Taiwan's most important international backer, though President Donald Trump has yet to approve a new [USN:L4N45S03H TEXT:"$14 billion"] arms sale package for the island. Taiwan's Coast Guard said in a statement about the militia boat and its accompanying vessels that their activities were all located outside of "restricted waters". In a practice dating to the 1950s, China's maritime militia, more commonly seen around [USN:L6N43M0E3 TEXT:"South China Sea"] flashpoints, consists of fishing vessels whose crews receive training and support to operate in disputed waters, often alongside coast guard ships. In June, Britain, France, Germany and the United States, all expressed [USN:L1N42W093 TEXT:"concern"] over Chinese activities off Taiwan's east coast as a threat to regional stability and freedom of navigation.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース山本、リーグ優勝決定Ｓ第2戦で先発へ 初戦はスクバル
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースのデーブ・ロバーツ監督は９日、ブルワーズとのナ・リーグ優勝決定シリーズ（７回戦制）で、１１日の第１戦にタリク・スクバル投手、１２日の第２戦に山本由伸投手を先発させると明らかにした。ＭＬＢ公式サイトが伝えた。

ドジャースはブレーブスとの地区シリーズを３勝１敗で突破。先発したスクバル、ブレーク・スネル、山本、タイラー・グラスノーの４投手は計２１回１／３を投げて自責４、防御率１．６９を記録した。今季のプレーオフ出場チームではレイズの先発陣に次ぐ２番目の好成績となっている。

地区シリーズで第３戦に先発した山本は７回を４安打１失点、１四球、１０三振と好投。中５日で第２戦に登板する予定で、シリーズが第６戦までもつれた場合も通常の登板間隔で先発できる見込み。

山本は昨年のワールドシリーズで最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選出され、最終第７戦では前日の登板から休養なしで救援登板した。今季のプレーオフでも短い登板間隔や救援での起用に応じる意向を示しているが、球団は可能な限り通常の登板間隔を維持する方針。

スネルがリーグ優勝決定シリーズ第３戦、グラスノーが第４戦に先発する可能性がある。ドジャースは昨年まで２年連続でワールドシリーズを制しており、３連覇を目指す。

item.title: Petroecuador levanta la declaratoria de fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE
item.description: La petrolera estatal ecuatoriana Petroecuador dijo el viernes que levantó la declaratoria de fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE y recuperó su capacidad de transporte a un flujo de 312.000 barriles por día.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La petrolera estatal ecuatoriana Petroecuador dijo el viernes que levantó la declaratoria de fuerza mayor en una estación de bombeo del oleoducto SOTE y recuperó su capacidad de transporte a un flujo de 312.000 barriles por día. La empresa había reanudado el bombeo a través del oleoducto el jueves, tras un incendio ocurrido a inicio de mes, que afectó a la estación de bombeo de Baeza y obligó a declarar la fuerza mayor en esa infraestructura. Petroecuador dijo en un comunicado que la víspera fue recuperada la sexta unidad de bombeo de la estación Baeza, permitiendo incrementar el transporte del crudo. La capacidad de transporte del SOTE es de 360.000 barriles por día (bpd). "El levantamiento de la fuerza mayor marca el retorno a la operación normal del sistema de oleoductos y posibilita la continuidad de los procesos de exploración, producción, refinación, comercialización nacional y entrega de crudo al mercado internacional", agregó la petrolera en un comunicado.

item.title: Boca Juniors empata en su visita a Instituto en liga argentina
item.description: Boca Juniors igualó el viernes 2-2 en su visita a Instituto de Córdoba en el inicio de la duodécima jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Boca Juniors igualó el viernes 2-2 en su visita a Instituto de Córdoba en el inicio de la duodécima jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino. Instituto mantuvo el liderato en la Zona A con 26 puntos en la tabla de posiciones, mientras que Boca quedó escolta con 21. En el partido disputado en el estadio Mario Kempes de la provincia de Córdoba, "La Gloria" abrió el marcador a los 14 minutos con un remate de Fernando Alarcón. Nueve minutos después, Boca Juniors empató por intermedio del ecuatoriano Enner Valencia tras una salida en falso del portero Marcos Ledesma. En el inicio del segundo tiempo, Instituto volvió a sacar ventaja a los 48 minutos con un gol de Jonathan Galván, mientras que Boca logró la igualada a los 56 gracias al uruguayo Miguel Merentiel. "Es un punto bueno ante un rival de jerarquía. Creíamos que lo podíamos ganar, pero nos terminan empatando dos veces", dijo Galván tras el empate. En otros partidos del viernes, Sarmiento venció 3-1 como visitante a Aldosivi de Mar del Plata, mientras que Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata y Atlético Tucumán empataron 1-1.

item.title: Ｆ１＝シンガポールＧＰスプリント予選、フェルスタッペンがトップ
item.description: ［シンガポール ９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［シンガポール　９日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の第１７戦、シンガポール・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は９日、スプリント予選を行い、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がトップタイムを記録した。

フェルスタッペンは１分３１秒１５６をマークし、２番手のジョージ・ラッセル（英国、メルセデス）に０秒１２０差をつけた。シンガポールでは過去に、ポールポジション（ＰＰ）獲得も優勝もともに経験していなかった。

フェルスタッペンは「ソフトタイヤを装着すると、マシンが少し生き返ったように感じた。トップになれるとは予想していなかったので、とてもうれしい」とコメントした。

３番手はシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ、フェラーリ）。総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）は７番手だった。

ラッセルは同日のフリー走行でトップタイムを記録したが、パワーユニットの部品交換に伴い、１１日の決勝では計４０グリッド降格のペナルティーを受ける。ただ、１０日のスプリントには影響しない。

スプリント予選の最初のセッションでは、セルヒオ・ペレス（メキシコ、キャデラック）が防護壁に衝突し、コース上に破片が散乱したため赤旗中断となった。その後、計時システムの不具合で第２セッションの開始が遅れたほか、追い抜き支援機能の作動にも問題が発生した。

item.title: Winless Kings head on the road to face Golden Knights
item.description: Still in search of their first win in the Peter Laviolette era, the Los Angeles Kings make the short trip to Las Vegas to face the defending Western Conference champion Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Still in search of their first win in the Peter Laviolette era, the Los Angeles Kings make the short trip to Las Vegas to face the defending Western Conference champion Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night. Los Angeles is 0-2-1 in its first three games under Laviolette, including road losses at Colorado (8-4) and San Jose (5-4 in OT). They come in off a 2-1 loss to the Florida Panthers on Tuesday in their home opener. Despite the slow start, the Kings, just one point ahead of winless Calgary at the bottom of the Pacific Division, remain optimistic about what lies ahead. "I'm just excited for us to put a full 60 minutes together," veteran Kings defenseman Joel Edmundson said. "I think we'll be a fun team to watch, a hard team to play against. We just haven't been able to get that full 60 (minutes) yet, but every day we're getting better and better." Captain Drew Doughty said it doesn't feel like his team is as bad as its record so far. "The first one (at Colorado) is the only one that feels like that," Doughty said. "San Jose, we shot ourselves in the foot. I thought we could have won that one." The Kings finished with 27 giveaways in the sloppy loss to the Panthers. "We just made more mistakes to give them opportunities than they did," Doughty said. "I don't think we need to adjust anything on systems. I just think we need to do them better, and when we get our chances, we've got to capitalize." Los Angeles will have to do it without forward Mats Zuccarello for the near future. Laviolette announced after practice Friday that Zuccarello would not make the trip to Las Vegas and is "week-to-week" with an undisclosed injury. Forward Jared Wright was recalled from AHL affiliate Ontario to take his place on the roster. Vegas comes in off a 4-3 shootout victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Thursday, rallying from a 3-0 first-period deficit in the process. Jack Eichel continued his hot start with a penalty-shot goal and an assist, Adin Hill made 21 saves and snapped a seven-game losing streak in shootouts, and 20-year-old rookie forward Trevor Connelly scored the winner in the fifth round of the shootout with a nifty move and backhand goal around the left pad of Sergei Bobrovsky. "I've been practicing a bit at the end of practice," Connelly said. "I knew I had a couple of moves that I thought would work. I just trusted my instincts and luckily it went in." It marked just the fifth time in team history that the Golden Knights rallied from a three-goal deficit to pick up a win. "I just think it shows how resilient we are, how up and down the lineup everyone is going to have an impact," Connelly said. "When we get down, we're not giving up." "I liked that we picked each other up," Vegas coach Ryan Craig added. "I liked that we stayed with it individually and as a team. I don't like going down 3-0, but there's something to be said with how we stuck together." --Field Level Media

item.title: India detains protesters, locks down Delhi ahead of rally against election chief
item.description: With metro stations and markets shut and mobile internet suspended, police boarded buses to check for protesters, witnesses said.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma, Aftab Ahmed, Sakshi Dayal
item.content:encoded: Police in the Indian capital detained scores of protesters on Saturday amid patrols by [USN:L1N45V075 TEXT:"thousands of security forces"], with travel and telecoms links suspended, in a lockdown to stop a youth protest asking the election chief to quit. The protest by the "Cockroach" youth movement, aims to draw thousands of demonstrators against Chief Election Commissioner [USN:L4N45K0DB TEXT:"Gyanesh Kumar"] over a [USN:L1N45V037 TEXT:"revision of voter lists"] that critics say favours Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party. Television images showed police in the central business district of New Delhi chasing down a few dozen young protesters, some wearing backpacks, before they were loaded into vehicles and hauled away. About 200 protesters were detained in the area, a police source told Reuters. Those detained outside Delhi included protest supporter Dhruv Rathee, a popular figure on YouTube, a police spokesperson said. With metro stations and markets shut and mobile internet suspended, police boarded buses to check for protesters after stopping them at points of entry into the city, with cars and other vehicles also subjected to checks, Reuters witnesses said. Barricades and concrete blocks stopped traffic, while anti-riot vehicles mounted with tear gas guns were stationed on key routes, they said. "Why is the prime minister so scared of the country's youth, the country's people?" Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the self-named 'Cockroach Janta Party' that called the protest, asked on Saturday, shortly before leaving for Delhi. "Why did you need to close all the railways, the metro, the internet has been closed, roads have been closed? ... this is nothing but fear," he told the ANI news agency in the financial capital of Mumbai. The protesters have said they plan to gather at Jantar Mantar, a protest site designated by authorities in the heart of New Delhi, at 10 a.m. NEW CHALLENGE TO MODI The protest, touted by the CJP as an effort to "Save Democracy", is planned as the biggest of a series of demonstrations launched last week after the Indian Express newspaper said Kumar's deputies had queried and disagreed with him over list revisions that dropped about 130 million voters. That number exceeds the population of Japan. Opposition parties have long accused the government of trying to fix voter lists to its advantage and were quick to resurrect the allegations following the report. Kumar has not commented but the Election Commission and the BJP have denied the allegations. The BJP says Modi's popularity and India's economic growth are key reasons for its electoral dominance and accuses opposition parties of misleading the country as they are unable to win elections. Nonetheless, the near [USN:L6N45U0IF TEXT:"daily protests"] by opposition groups pose a new political challenge to Modi, just months after similar demonstrations forced his [USN:L1N43R02E TEXT:"education minister to quit"] over exam paper leaks. They also come months before a series of key state elections starting in early 2027, among them one in the most populous state of Uttar Pradesh, ruled by the BJP. On Friday, Delhi police said they had not given permission for the protest and violators would face the force of the law. Their "temporary and precautionary" curbs aimed at regulating people's movement, preventing overcrowding, maintaining public order, and ensuring the safety of protesters and others in the affected areas, police said in a statement. CJP leaders rejected the police decision and said they would go ahead with the protest as it was their fundamental right. DELETIONS AFFECTED STATE POLLS, OPPOSITION ALLEGES The protesters accuse the BJP of using the revision of voter lists to sway election results, in collusion with its appointees in the Election Commission, including Kumar. Opposition parties say the voter deletions affected the outcome of some recent state elections won by the BJP, and have cast a shadow on the electoral process in the world's largest democracy. Election Commission data, also cited by the BJP, shows about 130 million names, have been deleted from voter lists during the verification exercise, including 63 million who relocated, 30 million who could not be traced, and 28 million dead. The commission says the count represents voter entries flagged during the draft revision stage, that the exercise is not complete yet, and voters wrongly removed can enroll again.

item.title: U.S. Expands African Critical Minerals Investments in Africa to Challenge China’s Dominance
item.description: By Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo The U.S. International Development Finance Corp plans to increase direct equity investments, including in Africa and the critical minerals sector, the agency’s Africa head said, as the U.S. steps up efforts to counter China’s dominance of key supply chains. …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo

The U.S. International Development Finance Corp plans to increase direct equity investments, including in Africa and the critical minerals sector, the agency’s Africa head said, as the U.S. steps up efforts to counter China’s dominance of key supply chains.

Critical minerals have become a focal point of global competition, with the U.S. and other major economies seeking to secure supply chains for electric vehicles and renewable energy, while reducing dependence on China.

The DFC, the U.S. government’s main investment arm, said in September it would invest up to $155 million in African digital infrastructure provider WIOCC , its largest ever equity commitment.

DFC Regional Managing Director for Africa Vibhuti Jain told Reuters that, where strategically significant, “you will see us deploy equity in addition to or in place of other instruments”.

“There are a number of projects in our equity pipeline right now, including in Africa, (and) including in the critical minerals sector,” said Jain, without providing details.

She said the DFC would continue to provide more debt financing, credit guarantees and political risk insurance than equity investments for the foreseeable future.

“But I think as the agency continues to grow, we will do more equity investments,” she added.

Attention on Critical Minerals Sector

Jain said the DFC has more than $14 billion of investment commitments across Africa and that critical minerals projects, or projects linked to the sector, are a major driver of new investments.

The DFC said more than $3 billion of those commitments are in critical minerals.

“So really, this is a sector to which we’re paying close attention,” Jain said.

In addition to financing a pipeline of African critical minerals projects, including rare earths developments and a graphite mine in Mozambique, the DFC is backing the rehabilitation of the Lobito minerals transport corridor linking African copper and cobalt mines to the Atlantic coast.

item.title: New-look Maple Leafs face tough road test against Avalanche
item.description: After overhauling their roster over the offseason, grabbing five points in the first five games is not a bad start for the new-look Toronto Maple Leafs.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After overhauling their roster over the offseason, grabbing five points in the first five games is not a bad start for the new-look Toronto Maple Leafs. They go for two more when they visit the Colorado Avalanche on Saturday night in the midpoint of a three-game road trip that started in Las Vegas on Thursday night. Toronto brought in eight new forwards, a new goaltender and a new head coach, looking to turn a last-place Atlantic Division finish in 2025-26 into a contending season. Jim Hiller, who was hired June 17 to lead the retooling, has experimented with different line combinations during games, trying to find the right mix of players. "Just try to change the vibe a little bit at different times," Hiller explained after Thursday night's 4-3 shootout loss to the Golden Knights. "Some players have been pretty consistent night after night. But as for three at the same time, we're still looking for that." The Maple Leafs made another move ahead of Saturday night's game when they brought up veteran forward Miles Wood from the AHL on Friday. Wood played two seasons with Colorado before being dealt to Columbus after the 2024-25 season. Toronto acquired Wood from the Blue Jackets before this season, and he should make his Maple Leafs debut against his former team. The new foundation for the organization starts with Gavin McKenna, the 18-year-old left winger who was the No. 1 overall pick in the 2026 draft. McKenna has played in every game so far and scored his first NHL goal in a 5-4 overtime win against Nashville on Tuesday night. McKenna will face arguably the toughest defensive corps in the NHL on Saturday night, headed by the top pairing of Cale Makar and Devon Toews. Colorado also boasts one of the top overall players in the league in Nathan MacKinnon, who has followed up his Rocket Richard Trophy-winning season with a hot start. MacKinnon has three goals and five assists already this year, including a goal and two assists in Thursday's 7-3 win at Calgary. The victory came one night after losing at Winnipeg on a last-minute goal. "Mentally, it's a grind to play back-to-backs and I think we have a really good head on our shoulders as a team of where we are and what we need to do in order to have success on the second night," Toews said. Colorado made significant changes to its roster, and one of the moves is working out well early this season. The Avalanche brought in veteran forward Jaden Schwartz, who had two goals Thursday night and three on the season. "He's been really good for us," Colorado coach Jared Bednar said of Schwartz. "A veteran guy. He's an incredible team guy. He does a little bit of everything for you. He's like a Swiss Army knife." The Avalanche could be without Logan O'Connor on Saturday night. O'Connor, who has not yet played this season due to a lower-body injury, is away from the team due to the sudden passing of his father, NHL veteran Myles O'Connor. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ella Langley show canceled over security threat; police say area is safe
item.description: Country music star Ella Langley's Friday night performance in Oklahoma was canceled shortly before it was scheduled to start over what the singer called a "serious security threat."
item.dc:creator: Lisa Richwine
item.content:encoded: Country music star Ella Langley's Friday night performance in Oklahoma was canceled shortly before it was scheduled to start over what the singer called a "serious security threat." Police said they conducted security checks after a caller warned of harm but found no credible threat. Langley, the singer of hit song "Choosin' Texas," had been scheduled to play at the 19,000-seat Bank of Oklahoma Center in Tulsa. About two hours before the planned start time, she and the venue alerted fans via social media that the show was called off. "Due to a serious security threat involving the safety of my fans, the venue staff, and my team, the incredibly difficult decision was made to cancel tonight’s show," Langley said in a Facebook post. "This decision was made under the advisement of local authorities, the venue, and my security team." A statement from the venue, known as the BOK Center, said that "after careful consideration, we have determined the show cannot proceed." Tulsa Police Captain Richard Meulenberg, in a video posted on Facebook, said his department did not advise canceling the event. The show was cleared to go forward after a standard security sweep with bomb-sniffing dogs, he said. After that, a person called "saying that someone was going to do great harm" at the event with "shots fired and bombs." Police conducted a second security sweep, Meulenberg said, and "advised the group that was supposed to be performing tonight that we could not find a credible threat." "Everything is safe," he added. Langley, 27, is a rising star in country music. "Choosin' Texas" made history last month after spending 23 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, breaking Mariah Carey's longstanding record of 22 weeks. "I know how much time, travel, money, and planning goes into coming to a show, and I can’t tell you how sorry I am," Langley said in her statement. "This is not a decision that was made lightly. I was so looking forward to spending tonight with you, but your safety will always mean more to me than anything else. I refuse to put anyone in harm’s way."

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝レブロン、シクサーズでのプレシーズン初戦で10得点
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のセブンティシクサーズに加入したレブロン・ジェームズ（４１）は８日、ネッツとのプレシーズン戦で移籍後初出場を果たし、１０得点５アシストを記録した。

レブロンはフィールドゴールの試投がわずか１本だったものの、フリースロー８本を全て成功させた。プレーしたのは前半のみで後半は出場せず、シクサーズは１０８─１１４で敗れた。

レブロンは試合後、「新しいユニホームを着ていたのは確かだが、バスケットボールはバスケットボール。コート上でプレーするものだ」と語り、これまで練習でともに汗を流してきたチームメートと実戦に臨めたことを喜んだ。

レブロンは７月、フリーエージェント（ＦＡ）として２年総額８００万ドル（約１２億７０００万円）、選手オプション付きの契約で加入。昨季はレーカーズで６０試合に出場し、１試合平均２０．９得点６．１リバウンド７．２アシストを記録した。

オールスター選出２２回を誇るレブロンは、通算出場試合数（１６２２）と通算得点（４万３４４０）でＮＢＡ歴代最多記録を保持。ヒートで２回、キャバリアーズとレーカーズで各１回、ＮＢＡ制覇を果たしている。

item.title: サッカー＝ＰＳＶが白星、佐野航大フル出場
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのオランダ１部は９日、１試合を行い、佐野航大が所属するＰＳＶアイントホーフェンはホームでヘーレンフェーンに２─０で勝利した。

佐野が先発したＰＳＶは前半２９分、右サイドからのクロスを相手ＧＫが弾くと、これをフース・ティルが頭で押し込んで先制。後半２３分にはＣＫから相手のオウンゴールを誘発した。佐野はフル出場した。

開幕から６勝１分け１敗としたＰＳＶは、暫定２位につけている。

item.title: Libya's military seizes narcotics after firefight with smugglers
item.description: Libya's military brigade seized more than 1.3 million narcotic pills after a firefight with smugglers in a southeastern town that injured three soldiers, the military said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Libya's military brigade seized more than 1.3 million narcotic pills after a firefight with smugglers in a southeastern town that injured three soldiers, the military said on Friday. The north African nation has become a major regional transit hub for synthetic drugs and other narcotics en route to domestic users and elsewhere in the continent, the UN said in January. In a statement, a military media unit said the Subul al-Salam infantry brigade in Kufra, about 1,700 km (1,000 miles) from the capital, Tripoli, targeted hideouts used by traffickers of narcotics and illicit goods. Pictures it posted showed soldiers standing around tens of transparent plastic small bags filled with round white pills bearing the number one and a sentence in black that read "made in Germany". The brigade operates under the Land Forces General Staff and owes responsibility to the military commander Khalifa Haftar of the eastern-based Libyan National Army. The statement gave no value for the drugs seized. Drug gangs have exploited the tumultuous situation in the country since 2011, the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime said in a January report. Libya plunged into a prolonged period of internal conflict and division after former ruler Muammar Gaddafi was toppled in a NATO-backed uprising that year. Five people were handed death sentences by a court in the Western Mountains region, about 160 km (100 miles) southwest of Tripoli, for importing more than 2 million pills of psychotropic substances, the attorney general said in October. (This story has been refiled to change the word 'responsible' to 'responsibilty,' in paragraph 5.)

item.title: ゴルフ＝米沢が20位、松山は30位に後退 ベイカレントクラシック
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、ベイカレント・クラシック・レクサスは９日、神奈川県横浜ＣＣ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、米沢蓮が日本勢最高の２０位につけた。

前日１７位の米沢は４バーディー、２ボギーの６９で回り、通算５アンダーの１３７。１２位スタートの松山英樹は３バーディー、４ボギーの７２とスコアを落とし、通算３アンダーの３０位に後退した。

同じく１２位で出た久常涼は７１で回り、通算４アンダーの１３８で２６位。金谷拓実と砂川公佑は３０位、岩田寛と石坂友宏は３８位、藤本佳則と細野勇策は４６位、香妻陣一朗は５４位、中島啓太は６１位、岩崎亜久竜は６３位、アマチュアの長崎煌心は７０位だった。

首位には通算１１アンダーでキース・ミッチェルとジェーコブ・ブリッジマン（ともに米国）が並んだ。ミッチェルは８バーディー、２ボギーの６５で６つ伸ばし、ブリッジマンは４バーディー、１ボギーの６８で回った。

item.title: Presidenta encargada de Venezuela autoriza operaciones de Starlink en el país
item.description: La presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, ha autorizado a Starlink —el servicio de internet por satélite operado por SpaceX, empresa de Elon Musk— a operar en el país sudamericano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, ha autorizado a Starlink —el servicio de internet por satélite operado por SpaceX, empresa de Elon Musk— a operar en el país sudamericano. La autorización forma parte de un acuerdo con la firma estadounidense, según informó el gobierno venezolano en un comunicado el viernes. "Con esta medida, se autoriza legalmente la prestación del servicio de internet satelital de la marca Starlink en todo el territorio nacional, lo que permitirá una operación formal con domicilio y fiscalización en el país. Con este otorgamiento, el Estado venezolano ratifica su compromiso con el ordenamiento del espectro radioeléctrico, el fomento de las nuevas tecnologías", agregó el gobierno en comunicado. La división de internet por satélite de la empresa ha seguido ampliando su base global de suscriptores, impulsada por el lanzamiento de satélites adicionales y una gama creciente de servicios para consumidores, empresas, el sector de la aviación, el ámbito marítimo y el gobierno

item.title: US-Ukraine-European negotiators meet in Miami as Trump announces diesel deal with Russia
item.description: Negotiators held six hours of talks to reach an agreement on a proposal to end the war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: Negotiators for the US, Ukraine and Europeans held six hours of talks in Miami on Friday with the aim of reaching agreement on a unified proposal to end the war in Ukraine, a person familiar with the talks said. The goal is to reach agreement on such a proposal in the coming weeks so it can be presented to Russia in order to seek a breakthrough before the winter, said the person, who spoke on condition of anonymity. The talks came on the same day that US President Donald Trump said Russia had agreed to [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"supply diesel to global markets"] in an effort to lower fuel prices, while his administration lifted sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues for the war. The deal was criticized by US lawmakers and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. "All that money goes toward the war against people, against Ukraine, against all of us. I believe our team is simply being used as a smokescreen. And that is certainly not fair," Zelenskiy said in a statement. Russian President Vladimir Putin said after a call with Trump that an immediate [USN:L1N45V0ZL TEXT:"resumption of peace talks was unlikely"], citing Ukrainian drone attacks on Moscow. The talks in Miami included US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner and delegations from Ukraine as well as representatives from Europe and NATO. The negotiators covered a lengthy list of topics in the discussions, including a post-war package for Ukraine that would include security guarantees from the US and from Europe, the person said. Also discussed were a post-war economic plan for Ukraine and a pathway to accession to the European Union for Kyiv, the person said. In a sensitive subject, the delegations discussed "some ideas" on territory, the person said, declining to elaborate. Ukraine has been adamant that Russia cede territory it has seized during the conflict. President Donald Trump has said both sides will need to compromise. The person said the delegations also discussed a Europe-Russia security architecture that would set the stage for peaceful years ahead. The person did not provide details.

item.title: Trump leva à Suprema Corte dos EUA ação contra Hillary Clinton relativa à eleição de 2016
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, solicitou nesta sexta-feira à Suprema Corte que restabelecesse sua ação judicial indeferida contra sua rival democrata nas eleições de 2016, Hillary Clinton, na qual a acusava de conspirar com o ex-diretor do FBI James Comey e outros para manipular a eleição daquele ano, associando sua campanha à Rússia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, solicitou nesta sexta-feira à Suprema Corte que restabelecesse sua ação judicial indeferida contra sua rival democrata nas eleições de 2016, Hillary Clinton, na qual a acusava de conspirar com o ex-diretor do FBI James Comey e outros para manipular a eleição daquele ano, associando sua campanha à Rússia. O presidente republicano entrou com o recurso depois que um juiz federal indeferiu o processo e impôs quase US$1 milhão em sanções contra Trump e uma de suas advogadas por terem movido uma ação “frívola”. Posteriormente, um tribunal de apelação dos EUA manteve o indeferimento e as sanções. Em 2022, quando já não ocupava o cargo após perder a eleição de 2020, Trump processou Hillary, Comey, o ex-oficial da inteligência britânica Christopher Steele, o Comitê Nacional Democrata e vários outros em uma longa ação movida no tribunal federal da Flórida. Trump, que tem um histórico de processar adversários, alegou que, na corrida para a eleição de 2016, Hillary conspirou com aliados para desacreditá-lo por meio de uma “narrativa falsa” de que ele e sua campanha teriam agido em conluio com a Rússia. A longa ação alegava “criminalidade organizada” e uma “conspiração para cometer falsidade prejudicial”, entre outras alegações. Trump derrotou Hillary naquela eleição, apesar de ter perdido o voto popular nacional, e cumpriu seu primeiro mandato de 2017 a 2021. Autoridades do governo dos EUA acusaram a Rússia de interferir na eleição de 2016, e uma investigação liderada pelo ex-chefe do FBI Robert Mueller documentou contatos extensos entre a campanha de Trump e agentes russos que buscavam influenciar a eleição a seu favor. Trump chamou a ideia de interferência russa de “farsa”. Desde que perdeu para o democrata Joe Biden em 2020, Trump tem feito alegações falsas de fraude eleitoral generalizada na eleição daquele ano. Trump reconquistou a Presidência ao derrotar a democrata Kamala Harris em 2024 e continua a fazer essas alegações falsas. O juiz federal Donald Middlebrooks indeferiu a ação movida por Trump contra Clinton, citando inúmeras falhas, incluindo o fato de Trump ter esperado tempo demais para apresentar algumas das alegações. O juiz comparou a ação de Trump a um “manifesto político de duzentas páginas que expõe suas queixas contra aqueles que se opuseram a ele”. Middlebrooks posteriormente ordenou que Trump e sua principal advogada no caso, Alina Habba, pagassem quase US$1 milhão em honorários e custas, impondo as sanções por terem movido uma ação que, segundo o juiz, tinha como objetivo “promover de forma desonesta uma narrativa política”. O juiz também repreendeu Trump e seus advogados por um “padrão contínuo de uso indevido dos tribunais”. Middlebrooks concluiu que a ação utilizou táticas processuais abusivas, continha alegações factuais “conscientemente falsas” e invocava teorias jurídicas “frívolas”. O Tribunal Federal de Apelações do 11º Circuito, com sede em Atlanta, manteve as decisões do juiz em 2025, incluindo as sanções.

item.title: Venezuela president authorizes SpaceX's Starlink to operate in the country
item.description: Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has authorized Starlink, the satellite internet service operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX , to operate in the Latin American country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has authorized Starlink, the satellite internet service operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) , to operate in the Latin American country. The authorization is part of an agreement with the US firm, the Venezuelan government said in a statement on Friday. The company's satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its global subscriber base, aided by launches of additional satellites and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services.

item.title: David Puig leaves LIV as Bryson DeChambeau reportedly eyes Europe starts
item.description: The DP World Tour, formerly known as the European Tour, may hold the key for many players departing LIV Golf.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The DP World Tour, formerly known as the European Tour, may hold the key for many players departing LIV Golf. Spanish youngster David Puig announced Thursday that he would not stay with LIV as it restructures for the future, switching his membership to the DP World Tour. And two-time major champion Bryson DeChambeau is reportedly weighing more starts in Europe, as well. "I don't see myself playing in the LIV 2.0," Puig told reporters at the Spanish Open, a DP World Tour event. "It's a decision I've made. I hope to play the European Tour next year, which I really enjoy, with a fuller schedule." Puig, 24, was a strong amateur golfer and starred collegiately at Arizona State. He played in two LIV events while still an amateur in 2022, when the league was still in its infancy, and signed with LIV once he turned pro. While Puig never won an individual tournament title in his four-plus years with LIV, he maintained eligibility for some DP World Tour and Asian Tour events and earned the biggest win of his career last November at the Australian PGA Championship. In pursuing full-time DP World Tour membership, Puig follows Spanish stars Jon Rahm and Sergio Garcia from LIV back to Europe. Puig played for Garcia's Fireballs GC while with the team-based league. Garcia was granted release from his LIV contract earlier this week. DeChambeau and Rahm, meanwhile, are among the small number of elite players whose decisions will make or break the so-called LIV 2.0 plan. Rahm made his decision known earlier this week that he would leave LIV, and golf insider Alan Shipnuck reported late last month that DeChambeau was still going back and forth on his final decision. The Telegraph reported that DeChambeau's team has contacted DP World Tour brass about which tournaments he could appear at in 2027. The report made clear that DeChambeau is not pursuing membership on the European tour, the way Patrick Reed did when he left LIV at the start of 2026, a path Rahm will now emulate. LIV members have until Oct. 25 to commit to playing for the league next year. LIV still needs commitments from a sufficient number of players with outstanding financial claims against the league to satisfy the terms set by its restructuring partner, BC Partners Credit. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝2位リヨンがランスに屈し初黒星、中村は途中出場
item.description: ［ランス（フランス） ９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ランス（フランス）　９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は９日、１試合を行い、２位リヨンは敵地でＲＣランスに１─２で敗れ、今季初黒星を喫した。リヨンの中村敬斗は後半１５分から途中出場した。

リヨンは前後半に１点ずつ奪われて２点のビハインドを背負ったが、後半３９分に相手が退場者を出して数的優位に立つと、直後に１９歳カリス・メラが相手守備陣のミスを突いて１点を返した。しかし、反撃もそこまでで、開幕からの無敗が途絶えた。

リヨンは勝ち点１１で暫定２位。一方、ＲＣランスは同７とし、１５位から暫定７位に浮上した。

item.title: UAW President Shawn Fain declares victory in race for second term
item.description: United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain declared victory on Friday in a race to maintain his position as head of the 400,000-member union.
item.dc:creator: Kalea Hall
item.content:encoded: United Auto Workers President Shawn Fain declared victory on Friday in a race to maintain his position as head of the 400,000-member union. Fain, 57, who rose to national prominence during a 2023 strike against General Motors (GM.N) , Ford (F.N) and Chrysler-parent Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , received a majority of the votes and easily topped five challengers, according to preliminary ballot totals released by a federal monitor overseeing the vote. Fain had widely been expected to win the balloting, which the Detroit Three automakers were watching closely as they look ahead to 2028 contract negotiations. The companies are wary of raising their labor costs at a time when the auto industry is grappling with weaker vehicle demand and intensifying competition. “One thing I know about our membership is they're ready to fight,” Fain said in an interview with Reuters. “They know they deserve better. And let's not fool ourselves. All these companies are massively profitable.” Fain has pointed to the next round of negotiations as an opportunity to secure gains beyond the union's landmark 2023 contract, which delivered wage increases of more than 25% over the four-year life of the agreement. The UAW is already urging members to strike in the spring of 2028, when current contracts with the Detroit automakers expire. GM, Ford and Stellantis did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Fain's declared victory late Friday. FAIN’S COMBATIVE APPROACH LED TO GAINS In 2023, just months after narrowly winning his seat, Fain took an unorthodox, combative stance against the automakers. He insisted on bargaining with all three automakers at once, a departure from past practice, in which the union got an agreement at one company to use as a template for the other two. Eventually, he launched simultaneous strikes at factories across all three automakers, a first for the union. “Shawn Fain will continue to take an aggressive approach to collective bargaining. The challenge this time will be that the companies will be well aware” of that approach, said Stephen Silvia, a labor expert from American University. DETROIT AUTOMAKERS LEERY OF LABOR-COST INCREASES Fain said on Friday that in 2028 he plans to push to restore pensions for all workers, a benefit that ended for new hires in 2007, around the time of the near-collapse of domestic US auto companies. GM, Ford and Stellantis, meanwhile, have been stung by tariff expenses, higher raw-materials costs and an expensive rollback of their electric-vehicle plans amid weak US demand. Executives are likely to push back against any meaningful labor-cost increases, said Marick Masters, business professor emeritus at Detroit’s Wayne State University. “The recipe is there for a major confrontation with the companies being in a less favorable position to withstand the pressures,” he said.

item.title: テニス＝マスターズ上海大会、坂本が3回戦進出 ジョコビッチは敗退
item.description: ［上海 ９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［上海　９日　ロイター］ - テニスのマスターズ上海大会は９日、男子シングルス２回戦を行い、予選勝者の坂本怜が第２３シードでロシア出身のアンドレイ・ルブレフを６─４、６─４のストレートで破り、３回戦進出を果たした。

世界ランキング１３７位の坂本は第１セットの第１ゲームでブレークに成功。第２セットも第９ゲームで相手のサービスゲームを破り、元世界５位の格上選手から金星を挙げた。３回戦では第９シードのアレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）と対戦する。

過去４回優勝の第１０シード、ノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）はフベルト・フルカチュ（ポーランド）に４─６、３─６で敗れ、初戦で姿を消した。

ジョコビッチはこれまでフルカチュとの対戦で８戦全勝だった。試合後、「北京でプレーしていた時の状態には程遠かった。少し疲れていて、フレッシュではなかった」と振り返った。

第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）、第３シードのベン・シェルトン（米国）は順当に勝利した。

item.title: サッカー＝なでしこジャパン、ハイチに5得点で大勝 国際親善試合
item.description: ［９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［９日　ロイター］ - サッカーの女子日本代表「なでしこジャパン」は９日、パリ近郊のサントゥアンでハイチとの国際親善試合を行い、５─１で大勝した。

前半に清家貴子が先制点を挙げた日本は、浜野まいか、長谷川唯のゴールで加点。１点を返されて３─１とリードして迎えた後半には、途中出場の千葉玲海菜、土方麻椰もネットを揺らした。

日本はこの後、１３日にドイツのブレーメンでドイツと対戦する。

item.title: Ukraine-Poutine minimise une reprise immédiate des discussions, dit le Kremlin
item.description: Le président russe Vladimir Poutine a dit vendredi à son homologue américain Donald Trump que Kyiv avait sapé la possibilité d'une reprise immédiate des négociations de paix trilatérales après avoir mené des frappes de drones à Moscou durant les élections législatives qui se sont déroulées le mois dernier, a fait savoir le Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président russe Vladimir Poutine a dit vendredi à son homologue américain Donald Trump que Kyiv avait sapé la possibilité d'une reprise immédiate des négociations de paix trilatérales après avoir mené des frappes de drones à Moscou durant les élections législatives qui se sont déroulées le mois dernier, a fait savoir le Kremlin. Vladimir Poutine avait dit que Moscou était prêt à reprendre les négociations avec Kyiv après la tenue des élections législatives. L'Ukraine a toutefois lancé des attaques contre la capitale russe et a frappé des bureaux de vote, ce qui, selon le chef du Kremlin, a mis en péril le processus de paix. "En lançant le jour le plus important des élections une attaque de drones à grande échelle contre Moscou, d'autres villes et des bureaux de votes, et en prenant pour cible certaines personnes impliquées dans l'organisation des élections, le régime de Kyiv a, en réalité, interrompu la possibilité d'une reprise immédiate du processus de négociation", a déclaré le conseiller du Kremlin Iouri Ouchakov. "Comme le président l'a dit, nous allons désormais évaluer quand ces négociations pourront reprendre", a-t-il ajouté au sujet des discussions trilatérales entre la Russie, les Etats-Unis et l'Ukraine. Iouri Ouchakov a indiqué que, durant leur appel, Vladimir Poutine et Donald Trump avaient abordé d'importantes initiatives économiques, notamment de potentielles livraisons de carburant russe. Donald Trump a annoncé vendredi qu'à l'issue d'une discussion "très fructueuse" qu'il avait eue avec Vladimir Poutine, la Russie avait accepté de livrer immédiatement plus de 300.000 tonnes de [USN:L8N45V1O6 TEXT:"diesel"] sur les marchés américain et mondial.

item.title: Alcolumbre pauta para 4ª-feira votação da PEC do fim da jornada 6x1
item.description: O presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), pautou a votação da Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) que extingue a jornada de trabalho conhecida como 6x1 e reduz a jornada de trabalho semanal para a próxima quarta-feira, quando ocorre a quinta sessão de discussão da matéria.
item.dc:creator: Maria Marcello
item.content:encoded: O presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), pautou a votação da Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) que extingue a jornada de trabalho conhecida como 6x1 e reduz a jornada de trabalho semanal para a próxima quarta-feira, quando ocorre a quinta sessão de discussão da matéria. Pelas regras regimentais, qualquer PEC precisa passar por cinco sessões de discussão para então ser votada em primeiro turno -- o Senado já realizou três dessas sessões nesta semana, e tem mais duas previstas para a próxima, na terça e na quarta-feira. "Pautei para quarta-feira (14) a votação, em primeiro turno, da PEC 221, de 2019, que trata do fim da escala 6x1", disse o presidente do Senado em nota distribuída por sua assessoria. "Cumpro, assim, o compromisso de colocar a proposta em votação, com responsabilidade, diálogo e respeito ao rito regimental. Caberá a cada senador e a cada senadora decidir com liberdade, consciência e convicção", acrescentou o senador. O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, que concorre à reeleição, é favorável à PEC e tem usado a defesa de sua aprovação como plataforma de campanha. Lula chegou a desafiar o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) -- que venceu o primeiro turno da disputa presidencial no domingo e enfrenta Lula no dia 25 de outubro --, e seu partido a votarem favoravelmente à proposta. Flávio, que se opõe à PEC, acusa Lula de estar sendo oportunista. O senador e seus aliados têm defendido em declarações públicas uma proposta alternativa que leve em conta uma jornada flexível e a remuneração proporcional à hora trabalhada, defendendo a prevalência de acordos individuais entre empregados e patrões sobre convenções coletivas. Caso seja aprovada em primeiro turno, com no mínimo 49 votos, a PEC precisa ser discutida por mais três sessões, para então ser votada em segundo turno. Segundo a Agência Senado, a líder do governo no Senado, senadora Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), está coletando assinaturas para um requerimento que possa acelerar o calendário de votação da PEC, de forma a ter sua tramitação concluída na Casa na penúltima semana de outubro, antes do segundo turno da eleição presidencial. A PEC em discussão no Senado prevê que a jornada de trabalho terá uma redução de 2 horas semanais das 44 atuais já nos 60 dias depois que a proposta for promulgada. A carga horária sofrerá um decréscimo de mais 2 horas um ano após a primeira redução. A proposta também estabelece o piso de duas folgas semanais, uma delas preferencialmente no domingo, e garante que não haverá redução de salário.

item.title: Trump takes suit against Hillary Clinton over 2016 election to Supreme Court
item.description: President Donald Trump asked the US Supreme Court on Friday to revive his dismissed lawsuit against his 2016 Democratic rival Hillary Clinton accusing her of conspiring along with former FBI Director James Comey and others to rig that year's election by linking his campaign to Russia.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Chung
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump asked the US Supreme Court on Friday to revive his dismissed lawsuit against his 2016 Democratic rival Hillary Clinton accusing her of conspiring along with former FBI Director James Comey and others to rig that year's election by linking his campaign to Russia. The Republican president filed his appeal after a federal judge threw out the case and imposed nearly $1 million in sanctions against Trump and one of his lawyers for bringing a "frivolous" suit. A US appeals court subsequently upheld the dismissal and sanctions. Trump's lawyers wrote in the appeal that Supreme Court review of the case is needed in order to protect the presidency. They wrote that the decisions by the lower courts reflect "a deeply troubling trend of federal courts using sanctions and disciplinary threats to punish the president and his lawyers for legitimate legal positions that those courts (erroneously) reject." In 2022, when he was out of office after losing the 2020 election, Trump sued Clinton, Comey, former British intelligence officer Christopher Steele, the Democratic National Committee and numerous others in a lengthy complaint filed in federal court in Florida. Trump, who has a history of suing adversaries, alleged that in the lead-up to the 2016 election, Clinton conspired with allies to discredit him with a "false narrative" that he and his campaign colluded with Russia. The lengthy suit alleged "racketeering" and a "conspiracy to commit injurious falsehood," among other claims. Trump defeated Clinton in that election, despite losing the national popular vote, and served his first term in office from 2017 to 2021. US government officials have accused Russia of meddling in the 2016 election, and an investigation led by former FBI chief Robert Mueller documented extensive contacts between members of the Trump campaign and Russian operatives who sought to influence the election in his favor. Trump has called the idea of Russian interference a "hoax." Since losing to Democrat Joe Biden in 2020, Trump has made false claims of widespread voting fraud in that year's election. Trump regained the presidency by defeating Democrat Kamala Harris in 2024, and has continued to make those false claims. 'POLITICAL MANIFESTO' US District Judge Donald Middlebrooks [USN:L1N30G0Q8 TEXT:"dismissed"] Trump's lawsuit against Clinton, citing numerous inadequacies, including that Trump waited too long to bring some of the claims. The judge likened Trump's lawsuit to a "two-hundred-page political manifesto outlining his grievances against those that have opposed him." Middlebrooks later ordered Trump and his lead attorney in the case, Alina Habba, to pay nearly $1 million in fees and costs, imposing the [USN:L1N345068 TEXT:"sanctions"] for bringing a case that the judge said was intended "to dishonestly advance a political narrative." The judge also faulted Trump and his lawyers for a "continuing pattern of misuse of the courts." Middlebrooks found that the lawsuit used abusive litigation tactics, contained "knowingly false" factual allegations and asserted "frivolous" legal theories. The Atlanta-based 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals upheld the judge's rulings in 2025, including the sanctions. "Many of Trump's and Habba's legal arguments were indeed frivolous," the 11th Circuit stated. In Friday's filing, lawyers for Trump and Habba said the time limit for filing the lawsuit should have been extended because he chose to defer suing during his first term in office in order to carry out his constitutional responsibilities as president. "This court's intervention is necessary to protect the presidency, and to prevent judicial disagreement from becoming a license to punish its advocates," the filing stated. Mueller, serving as a special counsel appointed by the Justice Department, issued a [USN:KCN1RU2MF TEXT:"2019 report"] on his investigation. The report stated that Russia "interfered in the 2016 presidential election in sweeping and systematic fashion," but also stated that "the investigation did not establish that members of the Trump campaign conspired or coordinated with the Russian government in its election interference activities." Mueller said in his report that he found "numerous links" and that the Trump campaign "expected it would benefit" from Russia's effort to tilt the election in Trump's favor. Trump's then-Attorney General William Barr appointed a different special counsel, John Durham, in 2019 to look into potential missteps by the FBI. In a [USN:L1N37C2MA TEXT:"2023 report"], Durham concluded that the FBI lacked "actual evidence" to investigate Trump's 2016 presidential campaign and relied too heavily on tips provided by Trump's political opponents to fuel the probe. Trump's Justice Department last year indicted Comey, one of several adversaries of the president hit with criminal charges, accusing him of making false statements and obstructing Congress after he was accused of lying about authorizing leaks to the news media. A federal judge subsequently [USN:S0N3U5043 TEXT:"dismissed the indictment"], finding that the prosecutor who Trump handpicked to prosecute Comey had been unlawfully appointed. Steele, working for an opposition research firm that was hired by a law firm on behalf of the Clinton campaign and the Democratic National Committee, produced a dossier that alleged ties between Trump's campaign and Russia as well as other salacious accusations, all of which Trump denied.

item.title: Em conversa telefônica com Trump, Putin minimizou chance de retomada imediata das negociações com Ucrânia, diz Kremlin
item.description: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, disse ao presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, nesta sexta-feira, que Kiev havia prejudicado a possibilidade de uma retomada imediata das negociações trilaterais de paz na Ucrânia depois de ter atacado Moscou com drones durante as eleições do mês passado, informou o Kremlin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, disse ao presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, nesta sexta-feira, que Kiev havia prejudicado a possibilidade de uma retomada imediata das negociações trilaterais de paz na Ucrânia depois de ter atacado Moscou com drones durante as eleições do mês passado, informou o Kremlin. Trump tem tentado, até o momento sem sucesso, intermediar um acordo de paz para pôr fim à guerra na Ucrânia, que teve início com a invasão russa em fevereiro de 2022. O secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, afirmou na quinta-feira que a guerra da Rússia na Ucrânia está em um impasse perigoso e que os Estados Unidos continuarão trabalhando em busca de um acordo para pôr fim ao conflito. Putin havia afirmado que Moscou estava pronta para retomar as negociações com Kiev após as eleições parlamentares russas do mês passado, mas a Ucrânia lançou ataques contra Moscou e atingiu seções eleitorais, colocando o processo de paz em risco, segundo ele. “Ao lançar um ataque maciço com drones contra Moscou, outras cidades e seções eleitorais, bem como contra indivíduos específicos envolvidos na organização da eleição, no dia principal da votação, o regime de Kiev efetivamente inviabilizou a possibilidade de uma retomada imediata do processo de negociação”, disse o assessor de política externa do Kremlin, Yuri Ushakov, sobre a ligação com Trump. “E agora, como disse o presidente, vamos avaliar quando essas negociações poderão ser retomadas”, acrescentou ele, referindo-se às negociações trilaterais envolvendo os EUA, a Rússia e a Ucrânia. Ushakov também disse que Putin e Trump discutiram importantes iniciativas econômicas durante a ligação, incluindo possíveis fornecimentos de combustível russo. Trump havia dito mais cedo, após a ligação com Putin, que a Rússia havia concordado em fornecer diesel imediatamente aos mercados dos EUA e globais, em um esforço para reduzir os preços dos combustíveis antes das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA no mês que vem, embora analistas tenham afirmado que as quantidades provavelmente não reduziriam os preços de forma significativa.

item.title: Queen Camilla on the joy of reading despite king's laughter and her tears
item.description: Britain's Queen Camilla and King Charles spend their evenings reading before dinner, a quiet time which is interrupted by either his laughter or her tears, she told a documentary aimed at reversing the decline in reading for enjoyment in the UK.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's Queen Camilla and King Charles spend their evenings reading before dinner, a quiet time which is interrupted by either his laughter or her tears, she told a documentary aimed at reversing the decline in reading for enjoyment in the UK. "When I'm deep in a book, I'll hear him roaring with laughter about something. It's very off-putting," she said, giving a rare glimpse of their private life at Clarence House. "Or I'll suddenly start weeping." Camilla, 79, has been a keen reader her whole life. After the success of a pandemic-era book club she set up on social media, she launched a charity to promote the benefits of reading three years ago. In Britain, the percentage of children and young people who enjoy books hit its lowest level in 20 years last year, according to the National Literacy Trust, which is now working with the government and Camilla's charity to try to turn this around. "I left school quite young, so reading has been most of my education. You learn so much about people, about life," Camilla told the documentary, "The Book That Changed My Life", which will air on the BBC on Wednesday. When Charles laughs out loud, Camilla knows he will be reading a book by "Jeeves and Wooster" creator P.G. Wodehouse. She said he also loved biographies, while she likes historical fiction and thrillers. She said books helped her father survive more than two years as a prisoner of war in Germany in the early 1940s, an experience he then wrote a book about. "You're not thinking of yourself when you're reading, you can immerse yourself into other people's lives and that does relieve the stress," she said. Charles is still receiving treatment for [USN:L8N44G0CW TEXT:"cancer"] and managing the fallout from [USN:L8N3Z81KN TEXT:"the arrest"] of his brother, Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, who denies wrongdoing, as well as negotiating the relationship with his younger son, [USN:L8N4590QP TEXT:"Prince Harry"], who has returned from the US to live in Britain. Meanwhile, "Swan Song: Diana, My Sister", a memoir by Charles Spencer, the brother of Charles' first wife, has become a bestseller. Buckingham Palace rejected in [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"unusually strong terms"] the book's version of conversations surrounding Diana's death in 1997.

item.title: Colombia firma nueve contratos mineros con inversiones proyectadas de 16,8 millones de dólares
item.description: Colombia firmó nueve contratos especiales de exploración y explotación de minerales estratégicos, como cobre, oro y fosfatos, con los que proyecta inversiones cercanas a 54.000 millones de pesos (16,8 millones de dólares), informó el viernes la Agencia Nacional de Minería (ANM).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombia firmó nueve contratos especiales de exploración y explotación de minerales estratégicos, como cobre, oro y fosfatos, con los que proyecta inversiones cercanas a 54.000 millones de pesos (16,8 millones de dólares), informó el viernes la Agencia Nacional de Minería (ANM). Los contratos se firmaron dentro de las Rondas Mineras 2026 y corresponden a Áreas Estratégicas Mineras en los departamentos de Cesar, La Guajira, Antioquia, Tolima y Huila, precisó un comunicado de la entidad. Ocho contratos son de la ronda de cobre, oro y polimetálicos, y uno es de la ronda de fosfatos. Entre las empresas que recibieron los contratos se encuentran la china Zijin Mining y OP Gold Capital, informó la ANM. Este modelo de contratación busca dar más seguridad jurídica a los inversionistas y reducir los riesgos, los conflictos y los tiempos de desarrollo de los proyectos, de acuerdo con la ANM. "Sigamos haciendo estos esfuerzos de generar más minería, más desarrollo, más riqueza, mejor economía, mejor educación para todas las regiones de Colombia", dijo el presidente de la ANM, Juan Camilo Valencia, citado en el comunicado. Al mismo tiempo, la agencia firmó 44 nuevas titulaciones mineras en 14 departamentos. Antioquia tiene el mayor número, con 10 títulos, seguida de Huila con nueve, Chocó con seis y Norte de Santander con cinco. Entre esos títulos hay 19 contratos de concesión: 11 de mediana minería y ocho de pequeña minería, que cubren minerales metálicos, materiales de construcción, minerales industriales y carbón. (1 dólar = 3.218,75 pesos)

item.title: Sequoia-backed chip startup Nuvacore raising funds at about a $2.5 billion valuation, sources say
item.description: Six-month-old microchip startup Nuvacore, which does not yet have a product, is raising hundreds of millions of dollars at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation to develop a new central processor designed for data centers, according to two people familiar with the fundraising.
item.dc:creator: Max Cherney, Krystal Hu
item.content:encoded: Six-month-old microchip startup Nuvacore, which does not yet have a product, is raising hundreds of millions of dollars at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation to develop a new central processor designed for data centers, according to two people familiar with the fundraising. Nuvacore is seeking to raise the funds as the appetite for central processors has swollen due to the thirst for data-crunching capacity to power chatbots such as Anthropic's Claude. CPUs perform vital functions as traffic controllers for Nvidia's AI chips and run autonomous AI software known as agents. The roughly $2.5 billion valuation has not been previously reported. The Information reported previously that Nuvacore was raising $200 million or more. The funding round has not closed, and the people cautioned that the valuation and size of the capital raise could change. Intel (INTC.O) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) , which use x86 technology, have long dominated the data center CPU market. Companies designing chips based on Arm's technology — found inside Amazon and Microsoft custom CPUs — have also attempted to make inroads in the data center market. Nuvacore has not yet developed a product. Last month, it described an unconventional design strategy: to build the core functionality of the chip before committing to an architecture such as the x86 used by Intel and AMD, or Arm, which is used in most mobile phones. The design strategy will allow the company's engineers to avoid the limitations and requirements of specific architectures and optimize a design for the type of computations that are most common in data centers and AI infrastructure, Nuvacore said. Nuvacore declined to comment. The San Jose, California-based startup was founded by renowned engineers Gerard Williams, John Bruno and Ram Srinivasan. Williams, a former Apple (AAPL.O) executive, sold a prior startup called Nuvia to Qualcomm (QCOM.O) for [USN:KBN29I1OO TEXT:"$1.4 billion in 2021"]. Nuvacore earlier this year announced a seed funding round led by Sequoia Capital. It joins a series of young chip startups that have sought billion-dollar valuations before releasing a product as investor appetite for AI hardware companies has returned. Over the past decade, Silicon Valley venture capital firms have taken much less interest in hardware than software because of hardware's longer development cycles, higher capital needs and the industry's cyclical demand. Investors put about $10.7 billion into semiconductor startups in the first five months of 2026, already outpacing the $12.2 billion raised globally in all of 2025, according to Crunchbase data. Earlier this year, Intel said it could not manufacture enough chips to meet demand, and was able to sell products it had previously determined were too faulty for sale. AMD also described swelling CPU sales in a recent results conference call with analysts. Shares in both companies have risen more than 180% this year. Nvidia (NVDA.O) launched a CPU called Vera this year. CEO Jensen Huang has said the company expects to [USN:L4N41V0P1 TEXT:"sell $20 billion worth"] of its Vera CPU in this fiscal year, which ends in January.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 9 : Six-month-old microchip startup Nuvacore, which does not yet have a product, is raising hundreds of millions of dollars at a roughly $2.5 billion valuation to develop a new central processor designed for data centers, according to two people familiar with the fundraising. Nuvacore is seeking to raise the funds as the appetite for central processors has swollen due to the thirst for data-crunching capacity to power chatbots such as Anthropic's Claude. CPUs perform vital functions as traffic controllers for Nvidia's AI chips and run autonomous AI software known as agents.  The roughly $2.5 billion valuation has not been previously reported. The Information reported previously that Nuvacore was raising $200 million or more. The funding round has not closed, and the people cautioned that the valuation and size of the capital raise could change. Intel and Advanced Micro Devices, which use x86 technology, have long dominated the data center CPU market. Companies designing chips based on Arm's technology — found inside Amazon and Microsoft custom CPUs — have also attempted to make inroads in the data center market.

Nuvacore has not yet developed a product. Last month, it described an unconventional design strategy: to build the core functionality of the chip before committing to an architecture such as the x86 used by Intel and AMD, or Arm, which is used in most mobile phones.  The design strategy will allow the company's engineers to avoid the limitations and requirements of specific architectures and optimize a design for the type of computations that are most common in data centers and AI infrastructure, Nuvacore said. Nuvacore declined to comment. The San Jose, California-based startup was founded by renowned engineers Gerard Williams, John Bruno and Ram Srinivasan. Williams, a former Apple executive, sold a prior startup called Nuvia to Qualcomm for $1.4 billion in 2021. Nuvacore earlier this year announced a seed funding round led by Sequoia Capital. It joins a series of young chip startups that have sought billion-dollar valuations before releasing a product as investor appetite for AI hardware companies has returned. Over the past decade, Silicon Valley venture capital firms have taken much less interest in hardware than software because of hardware's longer development cycles, higher capital needs and the industry's cyclical demand. Investors put about $10.7 billion into semiconductor startups in the first five months of 2026, already outpacing the $12.2 billion raised globally in all of 2025, according to Crunchbase data. Earlier this year, Intel said it could not manufacture enough chips to meet demand, and was able to sell products it had previously determined were too faulty for sale. AMD also described swelling CPU sales in a recent results conference call with analysts. Shares in both companies have risen more than 180 per cent this year. Nvidia launched a CPU called Vera this year. CEO Jensen Huang has said the company expects to sell $20 billion worth of its Vera CPU in this fiscal year, which ends in January.
